sloka: ममेष्टं नित्यशो हर्व्यैर्मन्त्रैः सम्पूज्य पावकम् ।सङ्ग्राममवतर्त्तुं च शत्रुनिर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ७.३०.१४ ॥
transliteration: mameṣṭaṁ nityaśo harvyairmantraiḥ sampūjya pāvakam ।saṅgrāmamavatarttuṁ ca śatrunirjayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 7.30.14 ॥

translations.english: My desire is to always worship the fire with oblations and mantras, and then to enter battle, desiring victory over my enemies.
